title: Entangled states grow exponentially and do not supervene on parts

statements.text: The dimension of the state space of a composite quantum system grows exponentially with the number of particles, as $2^n$ for $n$ spins. The events and states of an entangled system are produced by the whole, not its parts, so local supervenience does not apply.

sources.quote: for n spins, the number of independent states grows as 2n
The events and states of such entangled systems are produced by the complete system and not its parts.
